2607.19742.title: An Automated Framework for Extracting Reachable Attack Chains from Cyber Threat Intelligence Reports
2607.19742.paper_summary: Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) reports richly describe real-world attack processes, but their unstructured narratives cannot be directly used for automated attack-path reasoning. Existing CTI extraction methods focus on indicators, entities, or TTP labels without modeling the execution conditions and resulting states of each attack step, so the extracted knowledge supports neither state matching nor reachability analysis across multi-stage attack chains. This paper proposes an automated framework that extracts reachable attack chains by modeling each attack step as an attack unit of preconditions, an attack behavior, and postconditions. A multi-stage pipeline assisted by large language models (LLMs) extracts attack behavior skeletons, recovers their preconditions and postconditions, normalizes them into predefined predicates, and repairs broken dependencies; the resulting units are compiled into Datalog-style rules for attack-goal reachability reasoning. On a dataset of 20 CTI reports containing 334 human-validated annotated steps, our framework achieves higher annotated-step coverage than representative CTI extraction systems in recovering attack behaviors. Moreover, by explicitly generating preconditions and postconditions, it produces attack units that are more complete and consistent than those generated by end-to-end LLM baselines. On the extracted chains, Datalog inference reaches the specified attack goal in 19 of 20 reports, while backward search yields 34 attack paths under the generated rules. The source code and experimental artifacts are available in an anonymized repository. .
2607.19742.paper_summary_zh: 網路威脅情報（CTI）報告詳細描述了現實世界的攻擊過程，但其非結構化的敘述無法直接用於自動化的攻擊路徑推理。現有的CTI提取方法專注於指標、實體或TTP標籤，而未對每個攻擊步驟的執行條件和結果狀態進行建模，因此提取的知識既不支持狀態匹配，也不支持跨多階段攻擊鏈的可達性分析。本文提出了一個自動化框架，通過將每個攻擊步驟建模為包含前置條件、攻擊行為和後置條件的攻擊單元來提取可達的攻擊鏈。由大型語言模型（LLMs）輔助的多階段管道提取攻擊行為骨架，恢復其前置條件和後置條件，將其標準化為預定義的謂詞，並修復破損的依賴關係；最終生成的單元被編譯為Datalog風格的規則，用於攻擊目標的可達性推理。在包含334個經人工驗證的標註步驟的20個CTI報告數據集中，我們的框架在恢復攻擊行為方面實現了比代表性CTI提取系統更高的標註步驟覆蓋率。此外，通過明確生成前置條件和後置條件，它生成的攻擊單元比端到端LLM基準生成的單元更完整且一致。在提取的鏈上，Datalog推理在20份報告中有19份達成了指定的攻擊目標，而反向搜索在生成的規則下產生了34條攻擊路徑。源代碼和實驗材料可在匿名存儲庫中獲取。
